description: Why Schedule SE is per person: the first spouse's W-2 box 3 is $176,100, the full 2025 wage base, so their $50,000 profit (net earnings $46,175) owes only Medicare, $1,339. The second spouse has no W-2, so their own $50,000 owes OASDI $5,726 + Medicare $1,339 = $7,065. Total $8,404; one combined Schedule SE would have zeroed the second spouse's OASDI.
